content: AtomicSwComponentType can indicate whether an RTEEvent that starts an associated RunnableEntity is disabled in a certain mode Using the second mechanism, the AtomicSwComponentType can indicate whether an RTEEvent that starts an associated RunnableEntity is disabled in a certain mode. That is, RTEEvent s without an association in the role disabledMode are processed regularly according to their definition. RTEEvent s with the optional association disabledMode have the additional limitation that the associated RunnableEntity is not started when the ModeDeclaration referenced as disabledMode is active.
